## Ground-truth check (not used for tuning)

On 441 frames with a GT box and a person detection (conf ≥ 0.5), the IoU between the GT box and the best detection: median 0.766, 10th percentile 0.672. GT-STOP and detection-STOP agree on 0.995 of all checked frames.
